must_not_change: I pushed the fix to GitHub this morning, then I took the dog for a long walk around the park because the weather was lovely and the leaves were turning, and later we all watched the sequel together.

We moved everything to Kubernetes last spring, but this weekend was all about family: my sister drove up from the coast with her kids, we cooked a huge breakfast, went down to the river, and my nephew jason caught his very first fish.

My brother still writes TypeScript for a living, though these days he spends most evenings in the garden, fixing up the old shed, feeding the chickens and talking to the neighbours, and every autumn he makes a batch of home brew for the whole street.
